5. Water remains cool in earthen pots than in metal pots in summer. Explain why?

The earthen pot consists of a large number of small pores. Through these pores; water coines, is evaporated. For the evaporation, heat is absorbed from the water inside the pot. Since, the inside the pot has lost heat, it remains cold in the earthen pot during the summer.
